subject: general
question:
Study the given pie-chart and answer the question that follows.

The pie-chart shows the percentage distribution of the number of different types of chocolates distributed by Akanksha to the residents of a children's home, as percentage of all the chocolates taken together, that were distributed by her to these residents.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7374a1a13d28d50aa1ffabd033316b1b8bc7c71438ca0df162b1063d6ad9f18a.png] 

The average number of chocolates of Diary Milk, 5-Star and Snickers taken together is equal to the number of chocolates distributed of which of the given types?
solution:
Calculation:

Now, the average number of chocolates of Diary Milk, 5-Star and Snickers taken together

⇒ ((25 + 20 + 15)/3)% 

⇒ 20%

**∴ The average number of chocolates of Diary Milk, 5-Star and Snickers taken together is equal to the number of chocolates distributed by 5-Star.**
